dict.string: Hermes records the audio of one allowed application (for example a Discord stream or voice channel) so it can transcribe it for you, and one window of that application when you ask for a video. It never records the rest of the screen, and the microphone only when you ask for your own voice in a call.
Hermes records your own voice beside a call you asked it to record, so the minutes have both sides. Only when you ask, and you can mute it at any time.
